# Every button in the back-office

**Generated by `scripts/design-audit/collect-buttons.mjs` — do not edit by hand.**
Re-run it and commit the result; a hand-maintained list drifts from the code, which is the
problem this audit exists to expose.

**245 buttons.** 123 carry a styling class;
**122 carry none at all** and render as the plain browser default.

Why this file exists: a count is not reviewable. You cannot judge whether "four kinds
is right" without seeing what is actually in each bucket.
